title: Chapter 108
text:
Through the headlights, Han Xiao saw the armed forces of the enemy. All of them were armored vehicles, and they were charging toward him at high speed. Behind them were gunners.

The next moment, the mercenaries in the manor opened fire. The heavy machine guns roared, and the flames from the muzzles became the most eye-catching source of light in the dark night. Han Xiao was relieved. The number and firepower of the enemy were average, and they would not be able to break through the blockade of the mercenaries' machine guns.

"Bang!" Han Xiao heard the sound of a sniper rifle coming from the central bunker. The Hornet Brothers had made their move, and the two sniper rifles were very accurate.

Han Xiao looked at the area he was in charge of. The area was very small, and the angle was tricky. Only those who slipped through the net would dare to enter. At this moment, an enemy team happened to invade. He set up the Red Falcon, aimed, and fired. The shuttle-shaped bullets pierced through the necks of the enemies one by one, and clouds of blood burst out.

Big Beard was worried about Han Xiao's ability, so he took some time to take a few glances. Seeing that Han Xiao was basically hitting every shot, he was secretly shocked. He knew that he did not need to worry about this Mr. Black, so he did not turn around to observe and left the other area to Han Xiao.

First Round completed. You have received 20000 EXP.

Mission Requirement changed.

Second Round Mission Requirement: Guard River Valley Manor for three days.

Reward: 80000 EXP.

The first round was too easy, and the EXP seems to be too little. However, this increase is not bad.

Han Xiao stroked his chin. 20,000 for the first round, 80,000 for the second round. According to this ratio, the third round might be 320,000, and the fourth round would be over a million … Stop, this is a dream.

However, to be honest, the third round should be more than 150,000 EXP.

The second round would take three days, and Han Xiao felt that it was a waste of time. Suddenly, he thought about it and decided that he could stay here to earn more. He could borrow the equipment and lathes brought by the mercenaries and help them repair their equipment for free.

He was a man of action, so he immediately headed to the logistics area and found some maintenance workers. Most of these people were pseudo-mechanics who had learned maintenance as their secondary profession. There were only two proper Mechanic Supers.

"You want to help us repair it?" A maintenance worker was surprised. "You're a Mechanic?"

Han Xiao directly used his actions to prove it. He picked up a pistol on the workbench, dismantled it quickly, and then magically reassembled it. The whole process was done in one go, and it did not take more than two seconds. He was no longer a novice who needed forty seconds to assemble a pistol. With the various enhancements of his abilities, his manufacturing and assembly speed had already surpassed the limits of ordinary people.

The group of maintenance workers agreed without hesitation. They were even a little impatient.

Maintenance was hard and tiring, and it was also voluntary work. Since there was someone who volunteered to be the coolie, the maintenance worker could not wait to throw all the work to this official mechanic who had suddenly appeared.

…

Early in the morning, before dawn.

Chen Li carried a damaged machine gun and went to the logistics area to find a mechanic he was familiar with to repair it.

"Wang Xi, help me repair this machine gun."

Wang Xi was a thin, middle-aged man wearing a singlet. He was resting with his eyes closed. When he heard the question, he opened his eyes and looked at Chen Li. He said in a casual tone, "Leave it there. I'll fix it when I have time."

"Please hurry up. I might need to use it during the day."

Wang Xi said impatiently, "Alright, I'll fix it for you later."

Chen Li walked away helplessly. Although Wang Xi had a bad temper, he was a true Mechanic Supers with excellent skills. In order to not damage the machine gun at the critical moment of the battle, he could only ask Wang Xi for help.

After Chen Li left, Wang Xi closed his eyes again and started to nap.

Five minutes later, Wang Xi heard footsteps approaching again. He opened his eyes impatiently and saw that it was Chen Li. He said angrily, "What are you in such a hurry for? I'll fix it for you when the time comes. Stop bothering me."

Chen Li shook his head and said, "Return the machine gun to me. I'll find someone else to fix it."

Wang Xi frowned. Although he was unhappy that Chen Li kept bothering him, he did not want the machine gun to malfunction. After all, he was also in the manor. Thus, he softened his tone and said, "That person's skills are not good. I'll start fixing it when the sun rises. Is that okay?"

Unexpectedly, Chen Li insisted on getting the machine gun back. "No need. That person's skills are better than yours."

Wang Xi was instantly dissatisfied. The logistics area was only so big. Who did not know who was better? The other official mechanic was not as good as him, and those repairmen were even worse. Who were you trying to fool?

Under Chen Li's insistence, Wang Xi had no choice but to return the machine gun to Chen Li. Seeing Chen Li walk to the other side of the logistics area, Wang Xi had an idea and followed him. He wanted to see who this Mechanic that was better than him was.

As soon as he arrived, Wang Xi was shocked. He saw a group of salted repairmen surrounding a man in black. They were staring at the man in black. Their faces were filled with shock, envy, and eagerness to learn.

Wang Xi took a closer look and was stunned on the spot.

He saw that the man in black's hand speed was like a phantom, quickly operating all kinds of equipment and repairing multiple weapons at the same time. It was so smooth that it was scary. There was no need for him to stop and think. Wang Xi had never seen such a technique before. It could only be a mechanic with a higher level than him!

The repairmen originally had the mentality of throwing all the work to Han Xiao. However, when Han Xiao started his repairs, his extremely fast speed attracted all the repairmen. They were mesmerized by Han Xiao's performance. They wanted to take out a notebook and record every step of Han Xiao's. Many details gave them great inspiration.

If they had an interface, a message would appear — "You have observed Han Xiao (LV34) performing mechanical repairs. You have learned something. Repair skill proficiency increased."

Another mechanic, whose skill level was about the same as Wang Xi's, also stood at the side and looked at Han Xiao with a mesmerized expression.

Wang Xi realized that Han Xiao's technique was flawless. To be more precise, his skill level was not enough to find Han Xiao's flaw. He was depressed and wanted to turn around and leave, but he could not help but stop. He could not control his desire to stay and watch Han Xiao's technique. He was conflicted.

Without caring about the thoughts of others, Han Xiao was immersed in his repairs, and his experience increased rapidly. The effect of Level 1 Fine Repair was far better than Simple Repair. The two skills were not on the same level. Basic weapons and machines could be repaired very quickly. If it were not for the fact that the equipment was too simple, the efficiency could be increased even more.

For three consecutive days, other than resting, Han Xiao spent all his time fighting and repairing machines. In the three days, there were a total of four waves of enemies. There were yachts, armored vehicles, sneak attacks, and everything else. A group of enemies wearing frogmen suits tried to sneak in from the river in the west, but they were discovered and killed by the snipers.

The intensity of the enemy's attacks increased gradually. By the fourth wave, Han Xiao could feel that the guards of the manor were starting to lose their strength. After days of continuous high-intensity battles, the accumulated fatigue exploded, and mistakes and casualties started to appear.

The mercenaries' tough battle did not affect Han Xiao much. He was in charge of his own small area, shooting and shooting people. He realized that there were more and more 'fishes that slipped through the net', and the Hornet Brothers were starting to show their shortcomings.

Second round completed. You have received 80000 EXP.

"This is not bad. The third round is probably going to become really difficult."

Han Xiao woke up from his light sleep.

Adding the experience from the mission and the experience from the three days of manufacturing and killing enemies, he had received a total of 180,000 EXP. This efficiency was acceptable.

Mission Requirement has changed.

Third Round Mission: Resist the next wave of attacks.

Reward: 150,000 EXP

"It really is 150,000 EXP."

Han Xiao complained. This mission requirement made him feel unusual.
